keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Luis Cárdenas (Monterrey).
Substitution, Monterrey. Óliver Torres replaces Érick Aguirre.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Nathan Silva (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Pumas UNAM 0, Monterrey 0.
Substitution, Monterrey. Jorge Rodríguez replaces Diego Rossi.
Substitution, Monterrey. Luca Orellano replaces César Garza.
Carlos Salcedo (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Carlos Salcedo (Monterrey).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second yellow card to Carlos Salcedo (Monterrey) for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Robert Morales (Pumas UNAM).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Víctor Arteaga (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Pablo Bennevendo replaces Rodrigo López.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Israel Luna replaces Víctor Arteaga.
Goal! Pumas UNAM 0, Monterrey 1. Luca Orellano (Monterrey) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Orbelín Pineda.
Substitution, Monterrey. Fidel Ambríz replaces Lucas Ocampos.
Delay in match because of an injury Luca Orellano (Monterrey).
Delay in match (Pumas UNAM). VAR checking.
Álvaro Angulo (Pumas UNAM) is shown the red card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Alan Medina replaces Juninho.
Substitution, Monterrey. Luis Reyes replaces Jesús Corona.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Luciano Herrera replaces Rubén Duarte.
Goal! Pumas UNAM 0, Monterrey 2. Luca Orellano (Monterrey) left footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Óliver Torres.
Second Half ends, Pumas UNAM 0, Monterrey 2.
